why.why_reserving_fails: reserving under a column that cannot fit spends the deficit off the TOP: the masthead BOX lands at -5.42. Measured, that costs no ink (see ink_control), and the alternative — scoping the rule to the open pose — reds the drawer's drift gate. So the rule lands in both poses and the box overhang is the disclosed cost.
why.named_cure: make the closed GROW height-aware — gate the `html.drawer-closed .board-shell.shell-* { max-width: calc(100dvh - 9rem) }` block (GameBoard.vue scoped CSS, ~:930) and App.vue's `html.drawer-closed .masthead { --logo-scale: 1.05 }` on a min-height. GameBoard.vue belongs to another W7 executor (the kenken clear-receipt row), so it is handed off rather than edited.
why.why_not_scoped: scoping the reservation to the open pose makes the column height pose-dependent and walks the sheet's centre 15px across the close glide — e2e/drawer.spec.ts:219 reds at 18.09 against its <=6 bound, both engines. So the rule lands in both poses.
